applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations shown on Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21)
findings.comment: Transformer pad dimensions and clearance dimensions to buildings are not labeled on electrical or site plan sheets. No dimensions provided showing minimum 5-foot clearance from buildings, structures, or building foundations. Provide plan dimensions explicitly showing clearance measurements from all four sides of each transformer pad to adjacent building edges.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads located adjacent to internal driveway circulation loop
findings.comment: Transformer pad orientation (location of access doors) and clearances to driveway/circulation curbs not identified. Unclear whether fences/curbs are removable or ventilated per code definition, or whether transformers have operators/controls on all sides. Provide transformer access door orientation and confirm removable ventilated fence/curb details with dimensions showing 3-foot or 5-foot clearances as applicable.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads near buildings
findings.comment: Clearance dimensions from transformer pads to buildings not shown; cannot determine if reduced 3-foot clearances are proposed. If clearances less than 5 feet are intended, Austin Energy Design written approval must be documented along with verification of: (1) location not in confined space, (2) minimum 10 feet to windows/doors/ducts, (3) minimum 15 feet vertical clearance to windows/doors/ducts, and (4) 3-hour fire rating certification.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No building elevation or cross-section drawings provided showing whether balconies, overhangs, or structures exist above transformer locations. No confirmation that areas directly above transformers are clear of coverings or structures per code requirements. Provide building elevations or cross-sections for each transformer location confirming minimum 5-foot clearance from any overhead structures.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations near buildings
findings.comment: No transformer equipment type specified (oil-filled vs. dry-type) and no building elevations provided showing window/door/duct locations relative to transformer pads. Cannot verify minimum 12-foot horizontal clearance requirements or lateral separation distances for oil-filled equipment. Provide transformer specifications and building elevation drawings with dimensions.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads adjacent to internal sidewalks
findings.comment: Sidewalk locations and dimensions from transformer pad back edges to sidewalk back-of-curb not labeled on plans. Site Plan shows sidewalk notation (Construct 4' and 5' Concrete Sidewalks) but specific dimensions from transformer pads are not shown. Provide dimension lines from each transformer pad back edge to adjacent sidewalk back-of-curb showing minimum 2-foot clearance.

applicableAreas: If stairwells present - not shown on plans
findings.comment: No building floor plans or architectural drawings provided showing stairwell locations. Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) does not show any fire escapes or exterior stairs serving as fire escapes. Cannot confirm whether stairwells serving as fire exits exist adjacent to transformer locations.

applicableAreas: If oil-filled transformers and fire escapes present
findings.comment: No transformer equipment type specified (oil-filled vs. dry-type). Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) shows no fire escapes or stairs serving as fire escapes on any building. Cannot verify 20-foot minimum clearance requirement for oil-filled equipment. Provide transformer specifications (oil-filled vs. dry-type) and confirm fire escape locations.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations - access door side clearance
findings.comment: Transformer access door locations and orientations not identified. Hot-stick use area clearances (10 feet minimum) not dimensioned on plans. Electrical Design Plan shows transformer pads but does not specify which side has the access door or confirm 10-foot clearance to open area or adjacent structures. Provide transformer orientation and dimension access door clearances.

applicableAreas: If transformers located in confined spaces - not identified
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings or architectural plans provided showing whether any transformer locations face confined spaces (niches, vaults, or areas enclosed on 3+ sides). All five transformer pads appear to be in open configuration but requires cross-section documentation to confirm. Provide cross-section drawings for each transformer location confirming whether 10-foot or 15-foot hot-stick clearance applies.

applicableAreas: Fire hydrant locations relative to transformers
findings.comment: Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) shows two proposed fire hydrants but transformers are not depicted on that plan. Specific dimensions between fire hydrants and transformer pad locations not provided. Provide plan with both fire hydrants and transformer pads clearly marked with dimensions showing minimum 5-foot clearance.

applicableAreas: Trees in proximity to transformer pads and overhead electric distribution
findings.comment: Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) shows proposed trees and existing tree canopies near transformer locations but no tree species list is provided on Sheet 31. Tree List (Sheet 32) is referenced but specific species botanical names and utility-compatible status per ECM Appendix F 'UC' column not verified. Provide tree species list with explicit confirmation that all trees within 10 lateral feet of transformer pads and 15 lateral feet of overhead distribution are identified as utility-compatible per ECM Appendix F.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations adjacent to planting areas
findings.comment: Landscape Plan shows plantings throughout site, including in areas near transformer pad locations. Shrub and low-lying vegetation clearance distances (10 feet from access door side, 5 feet from other sides) not dimensioned. Transformer access door orientations not specified to determine which side requires 10-foot vs. 5-foot clearance. Provide landscape plan with dimension lines showing shrub/vegetation clearances from each transformer pad, with access door orientation clearly marked.

applicableAreas: Trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment
findings.comment: Landscape Plan shows trees throughout site but no root barrier details are provided. Underground electric routing is shown on Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) but tree locations relative to underground electric equipment not dimensioned. If trees are within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment, root barriers (minimum 4 feet deep, 5 feet from equipment per UCM § 1.10.10.4) must be detailed. Provide landscape details confirming root barrier specifications for affected trees.

applicableAreas: Dumpster locations relative to transformers
findings.comment: Site Plan (Sheet 9) does not show dumpster or trash collection enclosure locations. Without dumpster locations clearly marked, cannot verify 5-foot clearance requirement. Provide site plan showing dumpster locations with dimensions from transformer pads.

applicableAreas: Bicycle parking locations relative to transformers
findings.comment: Site Plan (Sheet 9) notes 41 bicycle parking spaces (39 long-term, 2 short-term) but specific locations of bike racks relative to transformer pads not shown or dimensioned. Provide plan clearly showing all bicycle parking rack locations with dimensions from transformer pads showing minimum 5-foot clearance.

applicableAreas: Light pole locations relative to transformers
findings.comment: No photometric plan or lighting plan provided showing light pole locations. Cannot verify 5-foot minimum clearance from transformer pads. Provide photometric or lighting plan with light pole locations dimensioned relative to all transformer pads.

applicableAreas: Fire lane routing relative to transformer locations
findings.comment: Fire Protection Plan (Sheet 10) shows fire lane routing but transformer pads not depicted on that plan. Specific distances between fire lanes and transformer locations not provided. Transformer pads appear to be adjacent to the internal driveway/circulation loop (which serves as fire lane). Provide plan with both fire lanes and transformers clearly marked with dimensions confirming minimum 15-foot clearance from fire lane edges.

applicableAreas: Spacing between multiple transformer pads
findings.comment: Five transformer pads shown on Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) but no dimensions provided showing spacing between pads. Provide dimension lines between all transformer pads confirming minimum 5-foot separation.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads relative to water infrastructure
findings.comment: Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) shows underground electric routing but water line locations not clearly dimensioned relative to transformer pads. Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19) shows water service connections but spacing from transformers not verified. Provide plan with both water lines and transformer pads clearly marked showing minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads relative to wastewater infrastructure
findings.comment: Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) shows underground routing but wastewater line locations and spacing from transformer pads not dimensioned. Utility Tap Plan (Sheet 19) shows wastewater connections but clearance verification incomplete. Provide plan with both wastewater lines and transformer pads clearly marked showing minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads relative to storm drain infrastructure
findings.comment: Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) references 'See Sht. 19 for Profile' but specific dimensions from transformer pads to storm drain lines not provided. Storm Sewer Plan (Sheet 12) shows storm infrastructure but relationships to transformer locations not dimensioned. Provide plan with both storm drain lines and transformer pads showing minimum 5-foot horizontal clearance.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads relative to gas infrastructure (if present)
findings.comment: No gas infrastructure shown on Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) or other utility plans. If gas service is provided to site, gas line locations and pressure classifications must be identified with clearance dimensions (24 inches for pipelines <60 psi, 36 inches for ≥60 psi). If gas service is present, provide utility plan with gas line locations, pressure ratings, and dimensions from transformer pads.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations relative to underground utilities
findings.comment: Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) shows some underground routing (water, wastewater, storm drain, electric lines) but complete clearance dimensions (12-inch horizontal and vertical minimum) from transformer pads to all utilities not provided. Provide comprehensive utility plan with all underground utilities and transformer pads clearly dimensioned.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to utility crossings
findings.comment: Electrical Design Plan shows multiple utilities on site but no confirmation provided that transformer pads or AE underground facilities are not located over/under other utility lines, nor that customer buildings/foundations are not installed over AE facilities. Provide plan or letter confirming no conflicts exist or provide details for any necessary boring/crossings per UCM § 1.10.5.B.

applicableAreas: Transformer locations relative to overhead electric distribution
findings.comment: Overhead electric line shown on Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) as '-OHE-' but no cross-section drawings provided showing 7.5-foot horizontal sky-to-ground clearance from overhead distribution conductors. Transformer locations and overhead line positioning not dimensioned vertically. Provide profile/cross-section drawings confirming minimum 7.5-foot vertical clearance from ground to lowest overhead conductor above each transformer location.

applicableAreas: Transformer locations and site features relative to overhead distribution
findings.comment: Overhead electric line shown on Landscape Plan but transformer pads not depicted on that plan. No dimensions or scaled measurements provided showing 15-foot radial clearance from overhead distribution primary and neutral conductors. Provide plan with transformer pads and overhead conductor locations clearly marked with 15-foot radius circles from conductors.

applicableAreas: If niche configuration present - not identified
findings.comment: Transformer pads appear to be in open/exterior configuration but no cross-section drawings provided confirming they are not in niches (accessible from outside but within building footprints). If any transformers are located in enclosed or notched-out areas, minimum 35-foot vertical clearance from grade through entire niche and entrance must be documented in cross-section. Provide cross-section drawings for each transformer location confirming open configuration or, if niche service, demonstrating 35-foot clearance.

applicableAreas: If niche service proposed
findings.comment: No indication that niche service is proposed. If niche configuration is used, must provide architectural specifications documenting 3-hour fire wall ratings for walls/ceilings, ventilation specifications, and evidence of consultation with Austin Energy Design business unit per UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 footnote 3. Confirm whether niche service is proposed; if so, provide required documentation.

applicableAreas: Transformer locations with overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas
findings.comment: No cross-section drawings provided showing vertical clearances in access paths to transformer locations. Buildings have underground/garage parking and varying floor elevations (FFE 683.0' to 687.5') but cross-sections demonstrating vertical clearances from transformers to overhead building elements not shown. Provide cross-section drawings for each transformer location showing vertical clearances to any overhead structures, parking garages, or enclosed areas above the pad.

applicableAreas: Oil-filled transformer pad locations (if applicable)
findings.comment: No transformer equipment type specified (oil-filled vs. dry-type). Grading Plan (Sheet 11) shows surface drainage flows away from buildings in transformer pad areas (positive finding), but confirmation that transformers are oil-filled equipment and that drainage direction is specifically maintained for liquid spill containment not provided. Provide transformer specifications confirming equipment type and, if oil-filled, verify grading plan prevents drainage toward buildings.

applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: Property boundaries shown on Plat (Sheet 2) and Site Plan (Sheet 9) but transformer pad locations relative to property lines not precisely dimensioned. Five transformers shown on Electrical Design Plan appear to be on property but specific confirmation that all pads are 100% on private property and not straddling property lines required. Provide dimension lines from transformer pad edges to property lines confirming all pads entirely on private property.

codeCitations: UCM § 1.10.4 Table 1.10.4 footnote 4 (property requirement); easement-specific regulations
applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations relative to recorded easements
findings.comment: Facts.md documents multiple recorded easements: (1) Greenbelt Access & Use Easement (0.31 ac, NE interior, not depicted on site plan), (2) City of Austin Drainage Easement (0.130 ac, NE corner, not depicted), (3) 10' Wastewater, 25' Drainage, 7.5' PUE from neighboring plats not verified on plans. Electrical Design Plan does not confirm transformer pads are outside all prohibited easements (drainage, water, sewer, overhead electric). Provide overlay/summary confirming each transformer pad is outside all easements or provide Austin Energy Design written approval if easement location is unavoidable.

codeCitations: UCM § 1.10.3 (additional clearance and access easements may be required)
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No separate transformer easements shown on Plat (Sheet 2) or other sheets. General 10' Public Utility Easement, 5' Electric Easements shown on various sheets but no specific easements dedicated for transformer access and maintenance. Austin Energy Design typically requires access easements around padmount transformers. Provide easement exhibit or letter confirming transformer easement requirements have been coordinated with Austin Energy Design and adequate easement width specified.

applicableAreas: Electrical routing from transformers to meters
findings.comment: Electrical Design Plan shows blue lines indicating electrical routing from transformers to building meters. Visual inspection shows routing appears to stay within property boundaries, but dimensions from electrical lines to property lines not provided. Confirm that all electrical routing from transformers to meters remains 100% on private property without crossing or passing through public right-of-way. Provide dimension lines verifying routing is outside public easements and property lines.

codeCitations: UCM § 1.18.0 (obtain transformer pad detail from AE Design)
applicableAreas: All transformer pad locations
findings.comment: No transformer pad dimensions shown on Electrical Design Plan or any detail sheets. No reference to or attachment of Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets. No specification of pad dimensions (length/width/depth), service type (single-phase or three-phase), or kVA rating. Provide Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets showing dimensions that match the specifications for the actual service type and load requirements of the development.

applicableAreas: Transformer pads located adjacent to internal driveway/vehicle circulation
findings.comment: All five transformer pads are positioned immediately adjacent to the internal driveway/vehicle circulation loop, within 4 feet of vehicle routes. No bollards are shown or called out on electrical, site, or detail sheets. No specifications provided for 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts or spacing to allow equipment door opening. Provide transformer pad detail sheet showing: (1) bollard specifications per AE Design standards, (2) bollard spacing layout allowing full access door opening, and (3) installation details.

applicableAreas: If overhead electric distribution present - located on southern boundary
findings.comment: Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) shows overhead electric line ('-OHE-') on southern boundary but no cross-section or profile provided showing vertical clearances from ground to lowest conductor. Buildings and site features shown but their heights relative to overhead conductors not dimensioned. Confirm no customer facilities (buildings, parking garages, light poles, signs, chimneys, antennas, tanks) are being installed under or over Austin Energy overhead distribution facilities. Provide profile/cross-section drawings showing vertical clearances.
